profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Branch
profile.summary:
Having worked as a computer consultant, independent contractor, an IT employee, and President and Director of several small corporations, Bill has developed a strong background in many areas, including mobile application development, information systems, resource planning and allocation, systems architecture and administration, application development, web development and deployment. 

Bill graduated summa cum laude from Bemidji State University with a bachelor's degree in computer science and mathematics.  He is a black belt in tae kwon do, has earned his private pilots license with instrument rating, retractable and high performance endorsements, and is a certified SCUBA diver.  Bill earned his HAM Radio Technician license in 2015 and upgraded it to a General license in 2022.  In 2022 Bill became a certified Minnesota DNR hunter safety instructor.  Bill also enjoys hiking, rock climbing, camping, fishing, and hunting.

In 2013, Bill was elected as a director of his political BPOU, became a member of the executive committee, and took over management of the BPOU website and email system.  Subsequently, he was elected Chairman of the BPOU where he served a 2 year term.  He has fostered relationships with many state senators and congressional representatives.  Additionally, he has volunteered in numerous capacities within the organization.  Bill continues to participate in this organization, currently serving as IT committee chair.

iPhone/iPod Touch development/Xcode, Cocoa, Obj-C

Specialties: Docker implementations, Java/Spring boot web services, Windows application/service development (C#/C++), ASP.Net web application / service development (C#), IIS Administration, PHP web development, Linux/Unix application development (C,C++,Python,Perl,Bash)

positions.description: Architect/Development lead for the Web API REST service layer supporting upgrade technology for Storage Center, Enterprise Manager, future appliances, and the suite of tools that support it.  Current project will result in an estimated savings of $4.75 million resource hours per year.

positions.title: Senior Mobile and REST Service Developer
positions.description:
Development of iOS and Android mobile applications that provide access to a broad variety of data services offerred by Telvent DTN.  These services include agricultural and weather data, maps and radar images, commodity technical research services (real-time and delayed), and more.  Development of java tomcat web and REST services utilizing Spring MVC 3, wink, flexjson, jackson, hibernate, and SQL Server.

Lead developer for the DTN Innovation Lab, a consortium of 10 highly motivated professionals including business experts, developers, and QA professionals.  The purpose of the lab is to overcome the obstacles of the normal DTN development process and to succeed where others have not.    

1 of a team of 2 developers that designed and implemented a state of the art, real-time stock and commodities technical analysis application, complete with watchlists, charts, studies, and news as a native application for the iPad platform.  

Designed and implemented a Agricultural Market Strategies application for the iPhone platform.  Application technology utilized included use of REST services, push notifications, and in-app purchases.

1 of a team of 2 developers that took over the maintenance of a pre-existing weather application for the iPhone.  This application provides real-time radar and additional graphical layers, real-time alerts, forecasts, dashboards, rain gauge, and news.

Sole maintainer of enterprise REST application layer for the Ag department, implemented using Tomcat, Java, Wink, Jackson, FlexJSON, SQL Server.

Tools: Xcode, Eclipse, Tomcat, Java jdk, Android sdk, Sql Server 2008 Management Studio, GIT, SVN, SourceTree, Cornerstone, MAC OS/X, Linux, Windows 7, Windows 2008 Server

company.name: Telvent DTN ( a Schneider Electric company)
